cards.text: Meet the boy Samuel, Hannah's son, who was given to the LORD (1 Samuel 1:20, 28). He serves the LORD before Eli, the priest (1 Samuel 1:9). And friend, something's different about these days in Israel.

cards.question: What's different about those days in Israel?

answers.text: The word of the LORD is rare
No rain has fallen in years
The lamp of God stays dark

cards.text: And Eli, whose eyesight has grown so dim he can't see, is lying in his room.

cards.question: The boy Samuel is lying down in the ___ of the LORD, where the ark of God is.

cards.text: The lamp of God hasn't gone out yet. Then the LORD calls to Samuel, and the boy answers, "Here I am."

cards.question: True or false: Samuel thinks Eli is the one calling him.

cards.text: Samuel RUNS to Eli. No snooze button, no stretching, just straight out of bed: "Here I am, for you have called me."

cards.question: Eli says he didn't call, and he tells Samuel to go back and ___.

cards.text: You ever get back in bed and get JUST comfy? Because once again the LORD calls, "Samuel!"

cards.question: True or false: The second time, Samuel stays in bed to see if he hears his name again.

cards.text: Up again, straight to Eli: "Here I am, for you have called me." Eli sends him back to lie down again, and the boy is now oh-for-two on figuring out who's calling.

cards.question: Twice now Samuel has heard his name and run to Eli. What hasn't happened for Samuel yet?

answers.text: The word of the LORD hasn't been revealed to him
He hasn't been brought into the temple of the LORD
He hasn't started serving the LORD before Eli

cards.text: For the third time the LORD calls, and for the third time Samuel shows up at Eli's side: "Here I am, for you have called me." Three for three. I bet Eli is about ready to put a lock on that door.

cards.question: True or false: This time, Eli realizes it's the LORD calling the boy.
Eli sends Samuel back to lie down. If the voice calls again, what does Eli tell Samuel to say?

answers.text: Ask the LORD to speak because he's listening
Ask the LORD to tell him who He is
Ask the LORD to come back in the morning

cards.text: So Samuel goes and lies down in his place.

cards.question: Samuel is back in his place. What does the LORD do this time?

answers.text: The LORD comes and stands there

cards.text: The LORD calls as before, "Samuel! Samuel!" This time, no running: Samuel answers, "Speak, for Your servant is listening."
The LORD has a listener now. And He says, "I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle."

cards.question: On that day, the LORD says, He will carry out against ___ everything He has spoken about his house, from beginning to end.

cards.text: The LORD says He told Eli He would judge his house forever, for the iniquity Eli knows about. So this isn't news to Eli.

cards.question: What is the iniquity the LORD says Eli knows about?

answers.text: His sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them
He stopped offering the yearly sacrifices at the temple
He let the lamp of God go out in the temple

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Samuel what He has sworn to the house of Eli. It's about whether this iniquity can ever be covered.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says enough sacrifices and offerings can still atone for the iniquity of Eli's house.

cards.text: Samuel lies down until the morning, then opens the doors of the house of the LORD. Now he's holding a hard message about Eli.

cards.question: Samuel is ___ to tell Eli the vision.

cards.text: Then Eli calls to him, "Samuel, my son." Samuel answers, "Here I am," and this time it really IS Eli calling.

cards.question: Eli asks Samuel what message the LORD gave him. What does Eli want from Samuel?

answers.text: Only the parts about his sons
A short summary for later on

cards.text: And Eli means it: "May God punish you, and ever so severely, if you hide from me anything He said to you."

cards.question: True or false: Samuel softens the message and leaves out the hardest parts.
Samuel tells Eli everything. How does Eli respond to the message?

answers.text: He says let the LORD do what He sees as good
He argues that the message is not fair to him
He tells Samuel to keep the whole thing quiet

cards.text: Samuel grows, and the LORD is with him. Three runs to the wrong room in one night, and LOOK at him now.

cards.question: As Samuel grows up, what happens with his words?

answers.text: The LORD lets none of them fall to the ground
The LORD makes all of them echo through the land
The LORD lets each of them shine like a lamp

cards.question: Word gets around. All Israel from Dan to Beersheba knows Samuel is confirmed as a ___ of the LORD.
Remember how the word of the LORD was rare? True or false: After this, the LORD keeps appearing at Shiloh, revealing Himself to Samuel by His word.

cards.text: And that's where we leave Samuel for now. Keep that apron on, friend, because this story's not done.
